snippet.title: FISHY - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
JOIN THE DISCORD:  http://discord.gg/fishyvr

FISHY is a brand new VR free to play, massively multiplayer cooperative fishing game. Catch and sell rare fish, fight off huge monsters, and hang out with your friends!
Collect rods with cool abilities: 
Fish up hundreds of rare and chaotic items! 
And its free to play! You can earn all the best stuff over time with free challenges. 

Fishy will release October 2026 on the Meta Quest Store. #vr #metaquest #virtualreality
